notes: LoadDataSourceFromFileToRAM: open (mode 6), size by seek and tell, read in chunks of at most 0x10000 bytes until a read returns nothing, close, then LoadDataSource(0, block, format, 0, unused). Argument order fixed to the listing (was shifted); the port stores the block as the listing does.

LoadDataSourceFromFile: LoadDataSource(1, path, format, 0, unused). The listing (asm 86f558) passes the path as stream_arg and the format as decoder_type; the port had the arguments shifted and now matches.

LoadDataSourceFromFileAsRAW: loads through LoadDataSourceFromFile, then ConvertToRawSource on the loaded handle. The listing passes the engine as the instance pointer and the loaded handle as the argument (asm 86f5a0), so the earlier partial reading was a Hex-Rays misreading.
LoadDataSourceFromFileEx: async bit 0x10000 gives LoadDataSourceAsync(1, path, format, 0, user, flags as uint16); bit 0 RAM; value 2 RAW; else file. Argument order as in the listing.
LoadDataSourceFromFileAutoDetectDecoder: extension after the last dot, lowercased as the listing does (bytes at most 0x60 get 0x20 added), wav 1, ogg 2, mpc 3, vxn 4, else empty handle.

LoadDataSourceFromFileAutoDetectDecoderEx: as the plain form, through LoadDataSourceFromFileEx(path, format, flags, user). The mangled name has a fourth stack argument (DataHandleUserData*) that the listing never reads; the port does not take it.

mpc_getsize: the listing reads the owner word at cursor +0x04 and calls its vtable slot +0x10 (StreamInterface::Size). Missing item: StreamCursorInterface has no owner word at +0x04 in the port, so the function returns 0. Closing it needs the owner pointer in the StreamCursorInterface base (a layout change in stream.hpp).

DecoderMPC8Cursor::Decode: buffered copy, decode loop and loop restart follow the listing. Two named gaps: (1) on the else path (count above remaining) the loop-restart seek takes r1, which the listing leaves as the clobbered return register of the convert or memcpy call (asm 86ff40 to 870008); the port passes the pre-update position. (2) the port stops when mpc_demux_decode returns 0 samples; the listing calls it again.

DecoderMPC8::CreateNewCursor: body ported as the free function vox::CreateDecoderMPC8Cursor. Missing item: installing it as the override needs the Musepack-linked cursor in the vtable of DecoderMPC8, which breaks decoder_mpc8_test linking.
Factory allocates a concrete DecoderMPC8 from the parameter block. Blocked on 0x8704ac: DecoderMPC8 stays abstract until CreateNewCursor is installed as its override.

DecoderNativeCursor::ParseFile: chunk walk (Afmt, Segm, Cues, Grpe, Rule, Plst, Stat, Trsn, Grps) is in place. Missing items: the header body words at +0x0c..+0x17, the Afmt id and size stores at +0x1c and +0x20, and the fmt bytes past +0x2f; Trsn gets the last Stat count where the listing reads a stack slot that only Stat writes.

DecoderNativeCursor C1: body reproduced. Partial only because header_words_ comes from ParseFile, which is partial (see 0x8738bc: missing header body words at +0x0c..+0x17 and the fmt bytes past +0x2f).
DecoderNativeCursor C2: same body as C1 (0x8742f4). Partial for the same reason: header_words_ from ParseFile (see 0x8738bc).

VoxMSWavSubDecoderIMAADPCM::DecodeBlock: reads one block and decodes it with ImaAdpcmDecodeBlock (tested). Missing item: the 89 int16 values of AdpcmDecoder::cAdpcmStepSizeTable (.rodata 9509412, 178 bytes) and the 16 bytes of cAdpcmIndexTable (.rodata 9509396). Not in this checkout (only symbol dumps), so the standard IMA tables are used.
get_stb_vorbis_struct_size: returns 0x5a8 (MOVW R0, #0x5A8; BX LR). The size query only; the stb_vorbis library itself stays unported (see NOTES.md Decisions).
streaminfo_gain: reads an 8-bit version, which must be 1, then four 16-bit fields at +0x28, +0x2e, +0x2a, +0x2c. Not confident of the upstream libmusepack name, so not reconstructed.

streaminfo_encoder_info: 7-bit profile scaled by 0.125 at +0x150, version name from a table, 1-bit flag at +0x14c and a 24-bit value. Not confident of the upstream libmusepack name, so not reconstructed.

RandomGroup C2 constructor: base constructor, sentinel, window and raw value, total weight 0. Missing item: the listing never writes +0x38, +0x44, +0x50 or +0x54; the port writes 0, -1, 0, 0, and the -1 at +0x44 is a port default the binary does not show.
RandomGroup C1 constructor: same body as C2 (0x881ad0). Same missing item: the -1 at +0x44 is a port default not written by the listing.

SequentialGroup::GetGroupElementPosition: advance, wrap, cycle and saved-state writes match the listing. Missing item: with an empty element vector the listing reads element 0 through a null begin pointer; the port does not reproduce that read.

RandomGroup::SetToPreviousState: saved values, reinsert pop, tail push, unlink and free match the listing. Missing item: with an empty removed list and a positive exclusion window the listing pushes the sentinel word, which the port reads as the window value.

RandomGroup::SetState(RandomGroup&): base copy, scalars and element pointers match. Missing item: when the removed list is empty and this vector is longer than the source, the listing relinks the head and the port leaves the ring open.

RandomGroup::AddElement: the listing copies the 8-byte element into a new block and returns the old total weight, and updates the count, window and total. Missing item: the port pushes the caller pointer and returns void; closing it needs native_playlist_walk.cpp to stop copying and return the weight.

UpdateOldSegmentState: copy of record C into B, play mode 2, zeroed record for no rule or non-positive frames, state 4. Missing item: the rule branch with frames, i.e. the rule-kind switch (cases 4, 5, 6, default) over the std::vector<int> copy of the loop-list entry at a1+0x2c, and the ramp sums.

UpdateCurrentSegmentState: index -1 branch and no-rule tail kept. Missing item: the element branch, which needs the std::vector<int> copy of the loop-list entry (as in 0x8847e8) and the slot 0x1c and 0x20 virtual results.

ApplyTransitionRule: kind-1 branch (next-dying test, swap, frame clamp) and state clearing kept. Missing items: GetPlaylistElement, TransposePlaylistParameters and SetPlaylistToPreviousState are not ported, so the element is cleared.
